parent_preregistration.policy: The parent preregistration remains unchanged and authoritative for its primary attack, sequential and scale contracts.

reason_for_amendment: A known seed-42 ablation shows that full-state transport improves parameter reconstruction but not every behavioral residual relative to first-moment transport.
The empirical-Fisher correction improved the known seed-42 L8 residual by 0.0179, below the previously stated 0.02 materiality threshold.
The independently stopped Retain-Retrain-P5 sensitivity endpoints expose a target mismatch rather than establish equivalence to converged retraining.
The registered one-exposure ML-1M requests have a small Original-to-Exact-Masked deletion effect, motivating a separately labeled stronger-signal analysis before attack interpretation.

known_before_freeze.policy: These observations are retrospective context and must not be described as prospectively preregistered evidence.

mechanism_stabilization.evidence_class: confirmatory extension with disclosed seed-42 prior observation
shared_requirements: no checkpoint selection from attack or FinalTest outcomes

arms.FM_source_only: First-moment AdamW transport with the response operator disabled.
arms.FS_source_only: Full-state AdamW transport with the response operator disabled.
arms.FS_empirical_fisher: Full-state AdamW transport with the currently reported blockwise empirical-Fisher correction.

reporting.summary: mean and sample standard deviation across seeds for each scenario

select_FS_source_only_if: For each scenario, mean local_residual(FS_source_only) - mean local_residual(FS_empirical_fisher) is at most 0.02.
For each scenario, mean relative_l2(FS_source_only) - mean relative_l2(FS_empirical_fisher) is at most 0.02.
The existing utility guardrails are satisfied.
fisher_removal.otherwise: Retain FS_empirical_fisher and describe the correction as secondary and non-uniform rather than a standalone innovation.

select_FM_source_only_if: FM_source_only has a lower mean local residual than the selected FS arm in both L8 and L4M4.
For each scenario, mean relative_l2(FM_source_only) - mean relative_l2(selected FS arm) is at most 0.02.
FM_source_only satisfies the existing utility guardrails.
fm_promotion.otherwise: Keep the selected FS arm as the primary method and retain FM as a diagnostic restriction.

selection_rules.freeze_before_attack: The selected arm is frozen before any new attack result is inspected. Any later change requires a new dated amendment.

stronger_signal_secondary_analysis.evidence_class: secondary; cannot replace the parent L8 and L4M4 primary scenarios

eligibility.ordering: ascending SHA256 of the public user association after eligibility and exposure stratification

adequate_effect_rule.interpretation: Adequacy permits attack interpretation in this secondary scenario; it does not promote the scenario to primary status.

stronger_signal_secondary_analysis.reporting_policy: Report every constructed request, including requests with weak effects or adverse BOTA movement.

equal_billing_long_horizon.horizon_definition: For each seed, take T_star from the already existing FullControl-P5 best Development checkpoint before running any amended masked or BOTA endpoint.
matched_schedule: Original-T_star, Exact-Masked-T_star and BOTA-T_star use the same initialization.
They use exactly T_star optimizer steps, the same ordered sample slots and the same full-batch denominator.
Exact-Masked-T_star zeros registered-user slot weights without compacting retained data.
BOTA-T_star uses the mechanism arm frozen by the mechanism-stabilization experiment.
equal_billing_long_horizon.retain_retrain_policy: Retain-Retrain-P5 remains an independently stopped converged sensitivity endpoint and is not used as the denominator for the fixed-T_star local residual.
equal_billing_long_horizon.interpretation_rule: Failure to move toward Exact-Masked-T_star limits BOTA to the validated 200-step horizon; success does not establish equivalence to independently converged retain-only retraining.

global_integrity_rules: Do not access, regenerate or inspect FinalTest while developing or selecting amended protocols.
Do not suppress a seed, scenario, arm, metric, null result or adverse result named here.
Do not use attack outcomes to select the BOTA mechanism arm.
Do not relabel a secondary stronger-signal or long-horizon result as a parent primary result.
Runtime-only fixes, logging and machine-local path changes are allowed only when numerical semantics are unchanged.
Any change to an arm, threshold, seed, request-selection rule, endpoint, metric or decision rule requires a new dated amendment before the affected result is inspected.
